provenance.primaryToFinalChange: Only checkpoint pause diagnostics: reset per-call pause and observe in finally on cancellation; collection policy unchanged. All extra pairs and native runs use final production source.

measurementLimits: Peaks sampled from root capture through final metric bookkeeping, not exact instantaneous peaks or entire-game-session memory.
peakManagedLiveBytes uses GC.GetTotalMemory(false), includes unreachable uncollected objects; not true live object graph.
No post-completion forced collection or progress-retirement probe used.
Ordinary GC and 1 GB region do not have a 20% memory improvement claim.
Time-limited requests can change explored work; observed selected routes equal, no universal decision equivalence guarantee.
No visible Steam, Windows or full combat deployment validation.

contracts.initialTestFailure: Original between-searches fixture incorrectly expected concurrent NoGC scope admission and hit its 5 s deadline; production serializes these scopes already. Corrected fixture waits for actual GC_MODE_WAIT evidence, verifies current checkpoint completes before releasing first scope, then queued scope enters. Final 7 pass.

nativeCommands.run-native.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
./tools/run-unattended-test.sh \
  --scenario-id ACTIVE-GC-NATIVE-REGENT \
  --character-id REGENT \
  --generated-scenario-path coverage/novelty-search/dev-03-regent-elite.json \
  --headless-instance active-gc-native-regent-20260922 \
  --headless-execution-mode exclusive --headless-memory-reservation-mib 18000 --headless-cpu-reservation 2 \
  --performance-preset-for-test High \
  --fixed-search-budget --force-short-search-only --short-search-budget-override-milliseconds 30000 \
  --search-beam-width-for-test 90 --search-max-expanded-nodes-for-test 2000 --search-max-degree-of-parallelism-for-test 2 \
  --enable-no-gc-region-for-test 1 --no-gc-region-budget-gigabytes-for-test 16 \
  --enable-detailed-diagnostic-logs-for-test 1 --stop-after-initial-solver-result-assertion \
  --evidence-directory .local/active-memory/native-regent --timeout-seconds 120 --cleanup-instance-on-exit \
  > .local/active-memory/native-regent-launch.log 2>&1
printf 'native-regent exit=%s\n' "$?"
./tools/run-unattended-test.sh \
  --scenario-id ACTIVE-GC-STRICT-DEFECT \
  --character-id DEFECT \
  --generated-scenario-path coverage/novelty-search/dev-02-defect-elite.json \
  --headless-instance active-gc-strict-defect-20260922 \
  --headless-execution-mode exclusive --headless-memory-reservation-mib 4096 --headless-cpu-reservation 2 \
  --performance-preset-for-test Low \
  --fixed-search-budget --force-short-search-only --short-search-budget-override-milliseconds 3000 \
  --search-max-expanded-nodes-for-test 300 --search-max-degree-of-parallelism-for-test 1 \
  --enable-no-gc-region-for-test 0 --verify-incremental-search --stop-after-initial-solver-result-assertion \
  --evidence-directory .local/active-memory/native-strict --timeout-seconds 120 --cleanup-instance-on-exit \
  > .local/active-memory/native-strict-launch.log 2>&1
printf 'native-strict exit=%s\n' "$?"
